summary: close the T096 final-evidence gate over the successor and A0012-era deliveries
owner_direction: Owner direction: close the final-evidence gate so that it can actually map the plan it now governs, repairing both open findings on it in one amendment. T096 must map each of T105, T106, T107 and T108 to its current goals and spec clauses and to independently reviewed evidence, keeping predecessor records as history rather than current proof. Recompute the post-rewiring dependency closure and add every dependency the gate needs: T108 must be an explicit dependency because no other ordinary PLANNED consumer carries it, while T105 to T107 may stay transitive only when the amended graph proves the path; the same recomputation must show that the tasks delivering the goals this gate claims to check are inside its closure, including the A0012-era T068, T069, T073, T087, T088 and T097 where the current closure still misses them, and the contract must name the tasks and the goals they carry instead of relying on an anonymous transitive path. Final traceability must resolve current registry-bound manifest, robustness, candidate-lock and authoring-guide artifacts and must never accept old-path evidence as current; predecessor evidence stays read-only and is linked, never rewritten. The gate blocks when any required delivery is absent, failed, cancelled, legacy-only or not independently approved. T108 registration guidance grants no permission, and T105 or T107 artifacts grant no execution or live authority; T096 must retain those distinctions. Verification must assert that the exact dependency closure contains the required tasks and that the final matrix carries positive, negative, compatibility, migration and old-path-unreachable evidence for each, including the T108 guide, example and drift tests. Preserve every still-valid obligation, acceptance criterion and Must-not clause; change only this contract and its dependency fields; do not touch any other task, document or revision; and resolve exactly the open impacts this amendment genuinely closes, leaving every other impact open and naming it.
